body.condition: The joint approximation error satisfies \(\gamma_n=\sup_{h\in H}\lVert\mathcal L_{P_{n,h}}(\widehat Z_n,\widehat{\mathsf G}_n)-Q_{n,h}\rVert_{\mathrm{TV}}\to0\).

novel.justification: This is a separate high-level approximation premise for the joint signal and estimated-game law. It is not implied here by sample splitting, legality, numerical boundedness, reverse deficiency, pointwise LAN, or differentiability in quadratic mean; it must be verified independently for the chosen construction, and no convergence rate is assumed.
